seiyuuAgency.title: Voice Agency Sim
seiyuuAgency.intro: You have a brand-new agency, and one contract to make somebody famous.
seiyuuAgency.rule1: Each month pick one of several jobs and send one talent; the wrong pairing usually flops.
seiyuuAgency.rule2: Signing rookies costs money, and a star on your books will catch a bigger agency's eye.
seiyuuAgency.rule3: An exhausted talent flops at anything, so training and rest are not dead cards.
seiyuuAgency.rule4: One item per month, so decide who benefits before you use it; put two talents together and they can take unit-only work.
seiyuuAgency.rule5: Events hit during the contract and demand a call; some options are gambles that settle on the spot.
seiyuuAgency.rule6: Your talents draw a monthly salary, so do the maths before signing anyone.
seiyuuAgency.preferredHint: Voice actresses from these franchises show up more often - both in your starting roster and at auditions.

legendary.name: Established agency
legendary.desc: All three start as veterans with high stats who can take big jobs at once - but wages run thirty percent higher.

academy.name: Training academy
academy.desc: Start with thirty-five percent more budget, cheaper wages and faster growth; everyone on the books is a rookie.

rookie.name: Rookie camp
rookie.desc: Two extra candidates every audition and cheaper signings, plus one more manager point - but the starting stats are low and have to be built up.

boutique.name: Indie studio
boutique.desc: The least money and the lowest wages, but the boss coaches in person: three extra manager points.

short.name: One year
short.desc: {{months}} months, quick - good for a first run.

standard.name: Two years
standard.desc: {{months}} months, enough to grow rookies and meet a few big events.

long.name: Three years
long.desc: {{months}} months, a slower build; you can even form two units.

agent.title: Manager points
agent.hint: {{total}} points, up to {{max}} per stat - and you can leave some unspent and just open the agency.
agent.linkHint: Got a SeiValue result code? Paste it in and your four axis scores decide where the points go.
agent.codeInvalid: That code could not be read - check the whole string got copied.

network.name: Connections
network.desc: Easier to sign veterans, and easier to land transfers.

eye.name: Eye for talent
eye.desc: Higher job success, and rookies are likelier to roll a good trait.

negotiation.name: Negotiation
negotiation.desc: Bigger cuts on jobs and bigger payouts from events.

care.name: Welfare
care.desc: Talents recover stamina faster and lose loyalty more slowly.

trainingCamp.name: Training camp

publicity.name: PR push
publicity.desc: Reputation +8, and bad event effects are halved this month.

giftTickets.name: Show tickets
giftTickets.desc: One talent gains loyalty +18 and fame +3.

photoShoot.name: Photo shoot

coach.name: Private coach
coach.desc: One talent's weakest of acting / singing / charm goes up 10.

scoutReport.name: Scout report

rerollOffers.name: Reroll offers

insurance.name: Flop insurance

radioVoice.name: Radio voice

varietySense.name: Variety sense

ironThroat.name: Iron throat

glassHeart.name: Glass heart
glassHeart.desc: Loyalty drops faster than most, so she needs attention.

workaholic.name: Workaholic
workaholic.desc: Pay +15% and faster growth, but higher stamina costs.

introvert.name: Introvert
introvert.desc: Variety is a struggle, but side roles come easier.

goldenEar.name: Golden ear
goldenEar.desc: Anything suits her: +8% success on every job.

stageBorn.name: Stage born
stageBorn.desc: Live shows and unit stages land more often, and cost less stamina.

leadMachine.name: Lead machine
leadMachine.desc: Enough leads booked: lead success and pay both rise.

radioQueen.name: Radio queen
radioQueen.desc: A full run of radio: more radio success and more exposure.

varietyStar.name: Variety star
varietyStar.desc: Known for variety, so variety work is easier to land.

ironBody.name: Iron body
ironBody.desc: High workload and high fame: stamina costs drop.

comeback.name: Comeback kid
comeback.desc: Plenty of flops and still standing: everything lands easier, loyalty included.

unitSoul.name: Unit soul
unitSoul.desc: Carried several unit stages: unit work is steadier and louder.

newcomerKing.name: Newcomer king
newcomerKing.desc: Fame built within months of debut: exposure and success both up.

livingLegend.name: Living legend
livingLegend.desc: Fame at the top, so every offer gets easier to talk up.

president.name: Voice actress president
president.desc: The one who answered questions in parliament.

cosmicNarrator.name: Cosmic narrator
cosmicNarrator.desc: The voice that narrated the Earth.
